index.title: Index
index.description: An index for the Google Calendar endpoint.

calendarId.title: Calendar ID
calendarId.description: The calendar ID to use as the source of event data.

clientId.title: Client Id
clientId.description: The Client ID of the Google Calendar application.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: The Client secret of the Google Calendar application.

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: The OAuth 2 access token for the Google Calendar application. This token typically expires after an hour. For long term usage, set the `refreshToken` property.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: The OAuth 2 refresh token for the Google Calendar application. The Google Calendar component can obtain a new `accessToken` whenever the current one expires. Set this value for long term usage.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: The number of milliseconds before the next poll.

syncFlow.title: Sync Flow
syncFlow.description: Specifies to sync events for incremental synchronization.

consumeFromNow.title: Consume from now
consumeFromNow.description: Specfies to consume events in the calendar from now on.
